start_urls.title: Start URLs
start_urls.description: Crunchbase discovery URLs to scrape (e.g., funding rounds pages). Defaults to recent funding rounds.

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to scrape per URL (includes pagination). Recommended: 2-3 to avoid rate limiting.

use_apify_proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
use_apify_proxy.description: Enable Apify Proxy for IP rotation and stealth. Highly recommended for production.

proxy_groups.title: Proxy Groups
proxy_groups.description: Apify Proxy groups to use. RESIDENTIAL is recommended for Crunchbase.
